# TOP UNION

> TOP UNION is a B2B poker infrastructure company connecting independent poker club owners to shared liquidity networks. We operate across three mobile poker platforms: PPPoker, X Poker, and ClubGG.

We serve poker club owners — not recreational players. Our network gives club owners access to 170,000+ active players, 24/7 table activity, and weekly settlements at a 7% flat commission (the lowest in the market).

## Platforms

- PPPoker: Club ID 3404
- X Poker: Union ID 7301
- ClubGG: Union ID 4453 (Europa Party)
